title: Tiresome
summary: TI'RESOME, adjective Wearisome; fatiguing; exhausting the strength; as a tiresome day's work; a tiresome journey. 1. Tedious; exhausting the patience; as a tiresome discourse. The debates in congress

inlines.v: TI'RESOME, adjective Wearisome; fatiguing; exhausting the strength; as a tiresome day's work; a tiresome journey. 1. Tedious; exhausting the patience; as a tiresome discourse. The debates in congress are said to be sometimes very tiresome
